## Go Modules

**Go Modules** (diperkenalkan di Go 1.11) adalah sistem manajemen dependensi resmi Go. File `go.mod` mendefinisikan module dan dependensinya.

## Membuat Module Baru

```bash
mkdir myapp
cd myapp
go mod init github.com/username/myapp
```

Ini membuat `go.mod`:

```
module github.com/username/myapp

go 1.21
```

## Menambahkan Dependensi dengan go get

```bash
# Tambah dependensi terbaru
go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin

# Tambah versi spesifik
go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.9.1

# Update ke minor terbaru
go get -u github.com/gin-gonic/gin

# Hapus dependensi yang tidak digunakan
go mod tidy
```

## go.mod & go.sum

`go.mod` setelah menambahkan dependensi:

```
module github.com/username/myapp

go 1.21

require (
	github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.9.1
)
```

`go.sum` berisi **hash kriptografis** untuk memverifikasi integritas dependensi.

## Semantic Versioning

Go modules menggunakan **semantic versioning (semver)**:

```
v1.2.3
│ │ └── PATCH: bug fixes
│ └──── MINOR: new features (backward compatible)
└────── MAJOR: breaking changes
```

Untuk major version >= 2, import path berubah:

```go
import "github.com/user/pkg/v2" // major version suffix
```

## Replace Directive

Gunakan `replace` untuk mengganti dependensi dengan versi lokal atau fork:

```
module myapp

go 1.21

require github.com/original/lib v1.0.0

replace github.com/original/lib => ../local-fork
// atau pin ke commit tertentu:
replace github.com/original/lib => github.com/fork/lib v1.0.1-fix
```

## Perintah go mod Penting

```bash
go mod init     # inisialisasi module
go mod tidy     # tambah yang hilang, hapus yang tidak dipakai
go mod vendor   # salin dependensi ke direktori vendor/
go mod download # download semua dependensi
go list -m all  # tampilkan semua dependensi
```

## Go Modules

**Go Modules** (introduced in Go 1.11) is the official Go dependency management system. The `go.mod` file defines the module and its dependencies.

## Creating a New Module

```bash
mkdir myapp
cd myapp
go mod init github.com/username/myapp
```

This creates `go.mod`:

```
module github.com/username/myapp

go 1.21
```

## Adding Dependencies with go get

```bash
# Add latest version
go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin

# Add specific version
go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.9.1

# Update to latest minor version
go get -u github.com/gin-gonic/gin

# Remove unused dependencies
go mod tidy
```

## go.mod & go.sum

`go.mod` after adding a dependency:

```
module github.com/username/myapp

go 1.21

require (
	github.com/gin-gonic/gin v1.9.1
)
```

`go.sum` contains **cryptographic hashes** to verify dependency integrity.

## Semantic Versioning

Go modules use **semantic versioning (semver)**:

```
v1.2.3
│ │ └── PATCH: bug fixes
│ └──── MINOR: new features (backward compatible)
└────── MAJOR: breaking changes
```

For major versions >= 2, the import path changes:

```go
import "github.com/user/pkg/v2" // major version suffix
```

## Replace Directive

Use `replace` to substitute a dependency with a local copy or fork:

```
module myapp

go 1.21

require github.com/original/lib v1.0.0

replace github.com/original/lib => ../local-fork
// or pin to a specific commit/fork:
replace github.com/original/lib => github.com/fork/lib v1.0.1-fix
```

## Important go mod Commands

```bash
go mod init     # initialize a module
go mod tidy     # add missing, remove unused
go mod vendor   # copy deps to vendor/ directory
go mod download # download all dependencies
go list -m all  # show all dependencies
```
